purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Rushan

queries.query: Rushan Shandong official cadastral map parcel service land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Shandong Geographic Information Public Service Platform and the Weihai natural-resources authority instructions describing its cadastral-map route. The Rushan public-resource portal also identifies Rushan Natural Resources Bureau, but no anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: 乳山市 不动产登记 地籍图 地理信息公共服务平台 官方
queries.result: Chinese-language first-party discovery confirmed the Rushan local registration service and the Weihai/Shandong public cadastral-map workflow. The official guidance says the platform can display cadastral districts, cadastral subdistricts and construction-land parcels, but the anonymous service schema, native parcel ID and geometry response were not exposed by the retrieved route.

registryEvidence.custodian: Rushan Natural Resources Bureau / Rushan Real Estate Registration Center, under Weihai municipal natural-resources and registration services
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Official Weihai guidance states that Rushan is within the Weihai real-estate registration service area and identifies the Rushan registration center. The same authority documents a public Shandong geographic-information platform cadastral-map workflow. This evidences a local registry/service custodian, not open citywide parcel-vector access.

parcelDiscovery.source: Shandong Geographic Information Public Service Platform; Rushan/Weihai real-estate registration service
parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was returned, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and no source-specific attributes are retained. No point miss or unavailable UI is treated as citywide absence.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official Weihai guidance reachable through first-party discovery. It names the Shandong platform route and says cadastral districts, cadastral subdistricts and construction-land parcels can be viewed; it does not provide an anonymous parcel feature URL, schema, CRS or bounded response.
Official notice confirms the Weihai registration service covers Rushan and names the Rushan Real Estate Registration Center. Procedural/local-custodian evidence only; no parcel geometry response.
Official Rushan public-resource portal reachable in discovery and identifies Rushan Natural Resources Bureau notices. No cadastral vector endpoint exposed.

Official Shandong platform landing page returned HTML 200. Retrieved JavaScript/configuration references service.sdmap.gov.cn:8081, www.sdmap.gov.cn:6443 and mapNumericalStatistics routes; no public anonymous parcel feature schema or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
Direct TLS-verified request returned HTTP 401 with JSON route-not-found response; no login, token, private credential or bypass used.
Direct TLS-verified request returned HTTP 401/route-not-found JSON without a request body; not a parcel response.
Direct TLS-verified request returned HTTP 403; no further access attempt or bypass.
Direct TLS-verified request returned HTTP 404 JSON. No parcel response.

One diagnostic curl used -k while troubleshooting these exact source hosts. No exception had been authorized, so those responses were discarded and were not used as evidence; all qualification decisions rely on TLS-verified requests or official published guidance.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [36.9091769310617, 121.539378077407] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
No exact-point hit or miss, map-extent miss, timeout, login wall, HTTP block, or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
A local Rushan registration custodian and an official provincial map lead are evidenced, but anonymous parcel ID, schema, CRS and geometry were not verified.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, title or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or admission. Independent serial review is required before adapter/runtime qualification.

Published guidance establishes that cadastral-map viewing exists, but does not establish public citywide vector coverage, update cadence, native ID semantics or CRS.
The diagnostic unverified-TLS retry was discarded and must not be treated as qualification evidence.

qualification.reason: Local registration and official cadastral-map service evidence exists, but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema or CRS was qualified.
